messages:
Maya: FYI — planning an atomic base-image rebuild this Sat 03:00 UTC. Goals: apply critical CVE patches (openssl, glibc), shrink rootfs, and attach cosign attestations. Need KMS gating and audit-log retention decisions. Who's in?

Devon: I'm in. Quick Q: do we need RBAC changes for the deployer role? Current `deploy-bot` has broad GCS/GCR access.

Juan: We should carve out a minimal `image-signer` SA with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.sign` permission and storage read for the signed bucket. Avoid giving deploy-bot blanket write.

sre-bot: Created ticket INC-2026 and maintenance window: https://tracker/internal/INC-2026 — Sat 03:00-05:00 UTC. Will post runbook link when ready.

Anna: Can we do a canary? Proposal: push rebuilt images to staging pool, run smoke evals and golden prompts, then a 10% rollout to production for 30m before mass cutover.

Maya: Canary plan sounds good. Also: audit retention question — Security requests 1y for signing/key-use logs; Ops wants 90d for runtime traces. We need to pick retention tiers and export destinations.

security-bot: Policy note — signing events + KMS key usage must be exported to our immutable audit cluster (write-once S3 bucket + index in ELK). KMS must be used as envelope only; never embed plaintext keys in CI artifacts.

Devon: Action: I'll draft an RBAC diff. Do we require MFA for humans holding `image-signer` permissions?

Juan: MFA for humans, yes. Service accounts will use restricted IAM conditions. Example condition: allow `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` only when `resource.name` == `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-sign` and `principal` matches `serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

Devon: Can you paste a sample IAM policy snippet?

Juan: Sure — sample policy (pseudo):

```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {
      "role": "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier",
      "members": ["serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"],
      "condition": {
        "title": "limit-to-image-signing-key",
        "expression": "resource.name == 'projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-sign'"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Juan: And for signing in pipeline: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/.../cryptoKeys/prod-sign@1 image:sha256:...` and generate SBOM with `syft packages -o cyclonedx image:sha256:...`

Devon: lgtm. Small tweak: require the `image-signer` SA to be restricted to the `images` namespace via IAM conditions. I'll include that in the RBAC PR.

Anna: Runtime rollback question: if the new images cause errors, we need an automated rollback to previous canary image and route traffic away from problematic nodes. Can we wire that into the rollout policy?

Maya: Yes — adding an automatic rollback hook: abort if error-rate >5% or p95 latency >200ms for 10m. Also adding a fallback route to previous pinned image.

Juan: Also attach SBOM + cosign attestation to the image metadata and surface an `image.version` header in request telemetry so we can correlate failures to a particular image build.

Maya: Good call — token-level telemetry to correlate requests -> image version will be enabled for the canary. That should speed triage.

security-bot: Reminder: HSM-backed keys required for prod signing per compliance. Confirmed with compliance: prod keys must be in HSM, rotation every 90d, and key use logged.

sre-bot: Ops will run readiness checks at T-30m and monitor metrics. Auto-abort if we see >5% error spike across endpoints. We'll post alerts to #incidents and page on-call.

Maya: Final checklist I'm tracking: 1) RBAC PR limiting signer permissions, 2) IAM condition policy, 3) cosign pipeline update (HSM KMS URI), 4) SBOM generation and attach attestations, 5) canary routing config + rollback hooks, 6) audit export to immutable store, 7) update incident runbook and monitoring. I'll open a parent PR with links to sub-PRs and tag owners.

Devon: I'll file the RBAC PR by EOD Fri and add a policy diff.

Juan: I'll update the pipeline job and add cosign + syft steps, and attach attestations in GCR metadata.

Anna: I'll prepare smoke test harness and canary gating rules.

security-bot: Also: ensure audit export is encrypted in transit + at rest, and that we keep a tamper-evident log. :lock:

Maya: Thanks all. Will post runbook + PR links when created. :thumbsup:
